trigger.first_authorized_empirical_attempt: stopped before source-target transfer scoring when the identity reader encountered a duplicate aligned FASTA header

preexisting_authority.reason: This rule was frozen before the original fresh phylogatR character-mask opening and is the inherited parser/admissibility contract. The host-specific wrapper omitted an explicit duplicate-header clause and its local mask implementation incorrectly admitted three species.

response_blind_header_audit.audit_information_used: FASTA header labels, frozen mask metadata and the preexisting duplicate-header rule only; no nucleotide differences, p-distance values, T_st or beta_R
response_blind_header_audit.repair_action: mark all three affected species inadmissible at the character-mask gate

required_requalification.only_geometry_change: remove the three header-inadmissible species and any targets falling below the already frozen minimum-five-source support rule

forbidden: retain duplicate-header species by changing the identity reader
inspect transient p-distance or post-IBD values to choose the repair
change the host-resource predictor, controls, dyadic model, alpha, power effect floor or synthetic world family
change any species for reasons other than the frozen duplicate-header admissibility rule
compute or inspect T_st or beta_R before repaired survivor requalification passes
